name: BoxSpecV2
status: V2.1: nine choices per side and PILE fees on frozen S1 tuples. Both generated twins enforce canonical contents and policies; live creation wiring remains M2-34/M3-32. Nothing here is deployed.
about: One BoxSpec describes a v2 box. Field ids 0-31, the Side and Branch tuples and reason numbers remain stable (F111; Amendment 3 C5.8). Box 0 and format 1 stay unchanged.

Each side has one choice: keep, burn, grow the pool, to holders in P, eat the price coin, or equally to every own-collection item in P; appended holders-in-T and items-in-T choices buy the box token after graduation. Both sides' fees arrive in the price coin P. There are no creator caps, recipe builder, splits or plug-ins in this release.

The menu is encoded in the existing Side tuple: keep = AsPaid then Creator; burn = BuyT then Eat, on either side; grow = AsPaid then Depth; eat the price coin = AsPaid then Eat (checked burn or permanent dead-address lock after graduation); holders = AsPaid then Holders with canonical uint8 currency 1 (P); items = AsPaid then Items with canonical uint8 insidePolicy 1 (Keep), 2 (BuyBackBurn) or 3 (Depth: inside shares grow the pool). NoSplit is required, branch b is zero and its params are empty. Every other combination is refused, never mapped to a button. The recipe key below describes wire decoding only; it does not offer arbitrary recipes.

Fields are checked in id order, then rules in order. Member checks run in slotOrder. A field's zeroWhen runs first. Add-on checks run at field 29. The first failing check returns (reason, field); OK is (0, 0).

Every enum is a uint8, with 0 not a member. Unused legacy enum ids remain identifiable but are refused. Params use canonical ABI encoding of the listed tuple members: decode, re-encode and compare bytes; refuse different offsets, gaps, dirty padding, out-of-type values and trailing bytes. Empty params are 0x.
Verdict field ids: core 0-31; Side sub-fields use 1000 times the side field id plus the offset in recipe.subFields; add-ons use 100 times the add-on id, plus the parameter's one-based index.

The factory builds the context from one permanent pricing listing, using its current raise at creation. ReleaseContext.listing carries that exact raise. A lister's update applies only to new boxes; existing boxes keep their recorded raise. There are no price bands, route checks, conversion targets or automatic box-coin listings.

Offered choices are controlled by release data, never network gates. The retained m1 context name now offers the six v2.1 choices and add-ons 1, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8. Add-ons 9/10 remain refused. Items need the own NEW_COLLECTION and an explicit inside policy; no missing-byte default. Holder wiring must provide role 17; the receiver refuses a zero ledger.

RC6 inbox: every box receives income through role 8 and its fee setup. CoW sells whole lots of foreign coins from the creation-time listing version for P, at most 20 lots per coin per hour. Each coin has a 30-day observed-progress in-kind exit; failed, unlisted and box coins exit in kind immediately. No conversion Safe.

Raw amounts and fee rates in policy data are decimal strings. Integer enum ids, field ids and ABI uint8/uint16 presets keep their wire representation. TABLE_MAX and CHUNK_MAX remain M1-60's measured byte limits; creator financial caps are removed.

stringRules.name: JSON_TEXT
stringRules.description: Printable ASCII 0x20-0x7E without '"' (0x22) or '\' (0x5C): the collection writes these strings into JSON unescaped. Control characters, DEL and every byte >= 0x80 (non-ASCII) are refused.

stringRules.name: SVG
stringRules.description: Printable ASCII 0x20-0x7E. Quotes and backslashes are allowed: the picture is base64-encoded before it enters JSON. Control characters and non-ASCII bytes are refused.

stringRules.name: URL
stringRules.description: A link: the URI characters of RFC 3986, so no space, '"', '<', '>', '\', '^', '`', '{', '|' or '}'; a non-empty link must start with https:// (BAD_CHARACTER otherwise).

reasons.name: OK
reasons.meaning: the spec passes every check

reasons.name: UNSUPPORTED_VERSION
reasons.meaning: format is not 2, or version is not 2

reasons.name: NOT_A_MEMBER
reasons.meaning: an enum or preset value that is not a member (a params member included, at its params' sub-field)

reasons.name: NOT_OFFERED
reasons.meaning: a known wire value that this release does not offer

reasons.name: OUT_OF_RANGE
reasons.meaning: a number outside its range

reasons.name: LENGTH_OUT_OF_RANGE
reasons.meaning: a string or byte string that is too short or too long (the table at most TABLE_MAX bytes)

reasons.name: BAD_CHARACTER
reasons.meaning: a byte the field's string rule refuses, or a non-empty link without https://

reasons.name: ZERO_VALUE
reasons.meaning: a value that must be non-zero is zero

reasons.name: MUST_BE_ZERO
reasons.meaning: a value that must be zero or empty is not: a token-only box's collection fields (n, firstId and pickFeeBps included), a NoSplit side's b, params of a member that takes none, a params member its `how` does not use, contentsParams outside SHOP or PILE

reasons.name: ADD_ON_PARAMS_MALFORMED

fields.name: boxType
fields.note: NEW_COLLECTION, TOKEN_ONLY, SHOP and PILE. EXISTING waits for a later version.

fields.name: firstId
fields.note: SHOP and PILE have no new collection: firstId and n are zero. Starter count is committed only by add-on 8.

fields.name: pricing
fields.note: One permanent listing per coin (F123). Listing 0 is native ETH, token address(0). The token must match its listing; the lister may update its raise, never replace its id or remove it.

fields.name: raise
fields.note: The exact listed raise in raw P units, recorded in the box at creation. The context supplies Listing.raise. A later update affects only new boxes (F123); no price read, band or relisting.

fields.name: openAt
fields.note: As format 1; at most 14 days ahead is the factory's check.

fields.name: deadlineDays
fields.note: Required: every v2 box can fail (F84, F93).

fields.name: buyers
fields.note: One menu choice for the side's 10/15, paid in P. The Side wire tuple is retained, with NoSplit and an empty branch b (Amendment 3 C5.8).

fields.name: sellers
fields.note: One menu choice for the side's 10/15, paid in P. The Side wire tuple is retained, with NoSplit and an empty branch b (Amendment 3 C5.8).

fields.name: metadataTable
fields.note: At most TABLE_MAX bytes; it stays in the spec (calldata), the chain keeps its hash and it loads in chunks of at most CHUNK_MAX bytes after creation (F96 R20C).

fields.name: creatorFeeRecipient
fields.note: Required exactly when a side keeps or add-on 4 is enabled. Otherwise zero in the spec; the receiver defaults its inbox payee to the creator. No cap add-on can require it.

fields.name: creatorBuy
fields.note: Pricing-token raw units, below the raise (rules).

fields.name: addOns
fields.note: add-ons.v2.json: at most 8 entries, ascending ids; per entry: in the catalog (ADD_ON_UNKNOWN at field 29), not reserved and offered by this release (ADD_ON_NOT_AVAILABLE), its box types (ADD_ON_CONFLICT), its params, its requires.

fields.name: contentsParams
fields.note: SHOP: canonical abi.encode(ShopConfigV2), with 1..64 unique nonzero collections and matching tiers. Both generated twins require seed covering two cheapest initially listed gives (F132), and check the full shop tuple and seed gate; initialization verifies ERC-721 usability. PILE: canonical PileParams (64 bytes, zero leave-behind) or PileParamsV21 (96 bytes, appended uint16 leaveBehindBps of 0 or 500). Native and zero seed allowed; pile fee choices require asset == pricing.token. Live admission checks listing and non-T; no contents elsewhere.

fields.name: pickFeeBps
fields.note: Share-vault pick fee only; zero for PILE and SHOP. Shop pick multiplier is in ShopConfigV2.

notInTheSpec.name: the listing's current data
notInTheSpec.why: Read from the registry at creation; the factory records the exact raise in the box. ReleaseContext contains only Listing; no routes or bands.

notInTheSpec.name: plug-ins
notInTheSpec.why: No plug-ins are offered in this release; plug-ins.v2.json has empty catalogs (F119).

notInTheSpec.name: fee split and protocol steps
notInTheSpec.why: Fixed for the release: 2/15 FIT, 1/15 platform, 2/15 pool, 10/15 the menu choice; buy-back and deepen share one step per pool per block, within 49 ticks. No converter, depth floor or financial cap.

notInTheSpec.name: Safe addresses and signatures
notInTheSpec.why: The release fixes FIT_SAFE and PLATFORM_SAFE; creator specs cannot change them. No Safe module (F121/F123).

notInTheSpec.name: links, rights confirmation and presets
notInTheSpec.why: Site and checker records remain off chain.

contexts.name: m1
contexts.status: M3: keep, burn, grow, holders and every-item P payouts on both sides; SHOP, PILE and add-ons 7/8 for SHOP. Name retained for generator compatibility. No caps or plug-ins.
contexts.listing: one pricing listing with its current raise at creation

about: Wire decoding only (Amendment 3 C5.8): the existing Side and Branch structs, enum ids and canonical params are preserved. Only the menu combinations pass; there is no recipe builder.
Both sides arrive in P. AsPaid keeps P; BuyT buys T for the burn button on either side after graduation. Every other leg is refused, even if a context offers it.

NoSplit alone; b must be all zero, including empty params. FixedShare, Cap30Days and PlugIn splits are refused. Legacy tuple descriptions remain only to decode and refuse old inputs without reassigning ids.

Holders use P only (M2). Items use frozen S1: every own NEW_COLLECTION item, no mode field, explicit Keep=1 or BuyBackBurn=2. Keep is the authoring default, never inferred from empty bytes. Id lists, outside collections and holder filters wait for a later version.

shop.validation: Full canonical ShopConfigV2 checks in both generated twins; BoxSpecV2Validator delegates
shop.seed: raw T, approved pull after creation; nonzero seed requires add-on 8 even with count/hash zero
shop.givePricesT: four strictly increasing nonzero raw-T amounts
shop.collections: 1..64 unique nonzero addresses; one tier 0..3 each; list and curator in contentsParams only
shop.failure: all shop T remains quarantined for burn retry; starter NFTs return to creator
shop.ceiling: saturating seedT * preset; fees counted; excess sellers share pays holders in P
